description: This pie chart illustrates the "Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)," displaying a total of three distinct categories. The largest segment, colored green and labeled "LOCAL," accounts for 94.5% of the distribution. The second category, colored red and labeled "LLM," represents 3.9%, while the smallest segment, colored blue and labeled "EDGE_P2P," makes up 1.6%. The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, the bolded category labels are positioned just outside their respective slices, and the corresponding bolded percentage values are displayed directly inside the segments. Visually, the two smaller slices ("LLM" and "EDGE_P2P") are emphasized by being slightly offset or exploded from the main body of the pie chart. The segments are arranged such that the largest slice dominates the visual space, with the two smaller, offset slices positioned adjacent to each other in the upper left quadrant, effectively ordered by descending size when viewed clockwise starting from the main green segment.
